resolved.reason: Container-growing reassurance supplies no diagnosis or remedy for declining plants in excessively draining soil. No new executable treatment is proposed.

harmfulness.reason: “I grow them in pots” does not recommend a harmful intervention. It also does not assess the deteriorating plants or provide care safeguards beyond noting prolific seed spread.

specificity_accuracy.reason: Names the right species but only discusses container culture and seed dispersal. It omits substrate moisture/nutrition and the confirmed less-draining repot.

feasibility.reason: Keeping plants in pots is easy and consistent with the setup. There is no actionable recovery procedure, so ease of doing nothing should not be mistaken for an effective executable solution.
